world.h: US strike on alleged drug boat kills 5 in Pacific
world.b: U.S. Southern Command said the strike in the eastern Pacific killed five people, bringing deaths from the military's boat strikes to at least 240 in more than 70 strikes.
world.title: U.S. military says 5 were killed by a strike on an alleged drug smuggling boat in the eastern Pacific

world.h: Putin hosts Qatar's emir, Iran's president
world.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage: Putin is hosting talks with Qatar's emir and Iran's president at a gas summit in Moscow.
world.title: Iran war updates: Putin hosts Moscow talks with Qatari emir, Iran president

national.h: Daylight saving time is ending again
national.b: Clocks fall back an hour, and standard time lasts until March 14. An AP-NORC poll found only 12% of American adults favor the twice-a-year changes.
national.title: Daylight saving time is coming to an end again. Here's how the time change may impact you

national.h: Ted Bundy tied to 1974 killing of Utah teen
national.b: DNA evidence led investigators to conclude Bundy killed 17-year-old Melissa Ann Smith, a long-cold case, Summit County Attorney Margaret Olson said.
national.title: Authorities say serial killer Ted Bundy is responsible for the 1974 murder of another Utah teenage girl

national.h: Oklahoma let oil firm linked to 1,000 incidents off
national.b: ProPublica found Oklahoma regulators allowed Citation Oil & Gas, linked to 1,000 pollution incidents and other violations, to restart operations without consequence after staff built a case to punish it.
national.title: This Oil Company Is Linked to 1,000 Pollution Incidents and Other Violations. Oklahoma Never Punished It.

politics.h: Grand jury declines to indict Cassidy Hutchinson
politics.b: A Washington grand jury rejected the Justice Department's request to indict the former White House aide, two people familiar with the matter told the AP.
politics.title: Grand jury refuses to indict former White House aide Cassidy Hutchinson, AP sources say

politics.h: Libertarians could sway GOP Senate races
politics.b: Republican-leaning states including Texas, Ohio, Kansas and Iowa are bracing for razor-thin Senate contests in which a few points for a third party could swing the outcome.
politics.title: Libertarians could siphon Republican support in the fight for control of the U.S. Senate

politics.h: Poll: Likely voters favor Democrats 52% to 44%
politics.b: A PBS News/NPR/Marist poll finds independents break for Democrats by 13 points, and likely voters say 2-to-1 that their midterm ballot is a vote against Trump rather than for him.
politics.title: What our final poll before Election Day says about midterms and Trump

international.h: Egypt court orders closure of Mada Masr
international.b: A court ordered one of Egypt's last prominent independent news outlets shut and fined editor-in-chief Lina Attalah three million Egyptian pounds ($53,400) for running a website without a licence.
international.title: Egypt orders closure of leading independent news site Mada Masr

international.h: Russia jails IT worker 13 years for Ukraine donation
international.b: A court sentenced Yuri Belenkiy, a former IT director, to three years in prison followed by 10 in a strict-regime penal colony for donating money to Ukraine. He was detained after flying to Moscow last year.

international.h: Protesters storm pro-Vucic TV station in Serbia
international.b: About 30 people entered the Informer TV newsroom Monday evening and surrounded its owner and editor-in-chief, Dragan Vucicevic, after Vucic's election defeat, live footage showed.
international.title: Protesters storm Serbian pro-Vucic TV station after his loss at polls

international.h: Russian strikes hit Kyiv's South Bridge
international.b: Overnight attacks on Kyiv included 16 ballistic missiles and more than 280 drones, and Russian forces struck again as crews dealt with the aftermath, Zelenskyy said, calling it a serious escalation.
Nearly half of the 10,060 confirmed cases have died in the fastest-growing and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country's history, according to its health ministry.

international.h: Drone strike on Nyala market kills 21
international.b: At least 21 people were killed and more than 40 injured in a drone strike on a market in Nyala, the de facto capital of Sudan's paramilitary RSF, a hospital medic said.

international.h: India evacuates thousands as Cyclone Arnab nears
international.b: The 'very severe' cyclone is expected to cross the Andhra Pradesh coast Wednesday with winds of 115-125km/h. More than 12 million people live along its projected path.

international.h: UK charges two after RAF Fairford incident
international.b: Mohmed Abdulkarim and Nouman Essghir, both 24, were charged under the National Security Act over an incident at the airbase used by the United States, the Crown Prosecution Service said.

international.h: Netanyahu, Eisenkot blocs tied in exit polls
international.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage: Updated exit polls show the Netanyahu and Eisenkot blocs tied at 51 seats each in Israel's election.
international.title: Netanyahu and Eisenkot blocs tied at 51 seats each, updated exit polls show

international.h: Russia pauses Kherson strikes for Oleshky truce
international.b: A localised ceasefire took effect Tuesday ahead of a US-led humanitarian mission to the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, which faces acute shortages of food and medicine, the Russian Defence Ministry said.

international.h: Flávio Bolsonaro leaves Brazil for the US
international.b: Bolsonaro, who refused to concede his presidential loss to Lula, left Brazil for the United States, according to multiple media reports. Trump suggested Monday, without evidence, that the election was 'rigged.'

business.h: Consumer confidence rises to highest since June
business.b: The Conference Board's October reading unexpectedly rose after hitting a 12-year low in September, though CEO Steve Odland said confidence is still on a general downward trend.
business.title: Consumer confidence ticked up in October. Is it just a blip?

business.h: New DOT rule changes flight delay compensation
business.b: Ten types of flight disruptions, such as aircraft damage from extreme weather or removing an unruly passenger, will no longer be considered the fault of the air carrier.
business.title: If your next flight gets delayed or canceled, compensation could look different

business.h: How Aldi is pushing down grocery prices
business.b: The German chain, now America's fastest-growing grocer, plans more than 3,000 U.S. stores by the end of 2028, more than any chain but Walmart. It had about $29 billion in U.S. sales in 2024.
business.title: How Aldi is pushing down grocery prices

science.h: OpenAI says AI made math and physics discoveries
science.b: Among the results, AI models proved the local smoothing conjecture, a central proposition of harmonic analysis, in every spatial dimension for the first time, OpenAI says. It had previously only been proved in three.

sports.h: Anthony Edwards to have knee surgery
sports.b: The Timberwolves star is headed for surgery on his right knee, with December the target for his return, per The Athletic, after scoring 47 points Monday in an overtime loss to Cleveland.
sports.title: Timberwolves star Anthony Edwards headed for knee surgery that will keep him out multiple months, per report

sports.b: Indianapolis is sending the defensive tackle back to the team that drafted him for a 2027 fourth-round pick, according to ESPN. The Colts also dealt Quenton Nelson to the Seahawks.

sports.h: Jay-Z to headline Super Bowl halftime show
sports.b: The NFL, Apple Music and Roc Nation announced Monday night that Jay-Z will perform at halftime on Feb. 14 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.
Kane is the first Englishman in 25 years to win the award after scoring 73 goals for club and country last season, setting records for Bayern Munich and captaining England to third at the World Cup.

sports.h: Brewers rout Rays 10-1 in World Series Game 3
sports.b: Jackson Chourio led a 16-hit attack as the Brewers improved to 7-0 in the NLCS and World Series. A Game 4 win would make them the first team to go 8-0 in those rounds.

sports.h: Ohio State stays No. 1 as upsets shake rankings
sports.b: Ohio State remains atop CBS Sports' Power Rankings over Miami. Top-10 teams have lost 11 times in three weeks, tied for the most in any three-week regular-season stretch since the AP poll began in 1936.

sports.h: WNBA sets Finals Game 6 for Thursday lunchtime
sports.b: Game 6 will be played at State Farm Arena at 12:30 p.m. ET on Thursday, Oct. 29, a decision announced just hours before Game 5 tipped off.

local.h: Sherrill says NJ election is secure
local.b: Gov. Mikie Sherrill said noncitizens have been taken off voter rolls after a software issue wrongly registered up to 6,600 at the Motor Vehicle Commission in 2023 and 2024.
local.title: NJ Gov. Sherrill: Election is secure, noncitizens taken off voter rolls

local.h: 1 killed, 4 hurt in Elizabeth vigil shooting
local.b: Shots rang out during a candlelight vigil in Elizabeth, New Jersey, Monday night. No arrests have been made, Union County prosecutors said.
local.title: 1 killed, 4 others injured at Elizabeth, NJ vigil shooting

local.b: Rashaun Donovan, 48, faces attempted murder charges after a night of violence at a Southeast Queens home that ended with an NYPD officer shooting and injuring a woman.
local.title: Police arrest man in Queens stabbings that ended with officer shooting woman

local.h: Woman found in shallow grave in Queens
local.b: Seraphina Pereira, 35, was found shot in the head and buried near a cricket field in Edgemere. Her ex-boyfriend is in custody with charges pending, police said.
local.title: Ex-boyfriend of woman found in shallow grave in Queens charged with murder, NYPD says

local.h: NJ activists frustrated over ICE warehouse response
local.b: Immigration activists and a Dover council member say state officials have been lukewarm since ICE admitted using a warehouse in Roxbury to process detainees.
local.title: ICE used a warehouse in NJ. Locals are ‘frustrated’ by Sherrill’s response.

local.h: Ex-detective again faces murder charge in GWB killing
local.b: A grand jury indicted Victor Romero, 62, on second-degree murder in the road-rage shooting death of Koran Irvine on the George Washington Bridge, after prosecutors had downgraded the charge to manslaughter.
local.title: Ex-NYPD officer again faces murder charge in George Washington Bridge shooting

periods.text: Partly cloudy, with a low around 49. Northeast wind around 5 mph.

periods.name: Wednesday
periods.text: Partly sunny, with a high near 63. Light and variable wind becoming south 5 to 7 mph in the afternoon.

periods.name: Wednesday Night
periods.text: Cloudy during the early evening, then gradual clearing, with a low around 54. South wind around 6 mph becoming light and variable  after midnight.

periods.name: Thursday
periods.text: Partly sunny, then gradually becoming sunny, with a high near 68. Calm wind becoming southwest 5 to 9 mph in the morning.

periods.name: Thursday Night
periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 59. Southwest wind 7 to 9 mph.
